title: DNS SVCB RFC 9461 Endpoint Selection Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, full solution test, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9461 DNS SVCB endpoint-selection surface.
scope: This verification covers SVCB incompatibility without ALPN or an equivalent supported protocol key, HTTP ALPN `dohpath` requirements, HTTPS SvcParam carry-through to HTTP connections, separate endpoint candidates by per-transport default port, respected versus ignored `port` keys, relative DoH URI-template validation with a `dns` variable, valid DoH path expansion, DoH origin host/port selection, and default-port behavior.
preconditions: The RFC 9461 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9461.json`.
SVCB endpoint selection remains in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` and does not perform DNS network I/O or QUIC connection setup.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9461 selection tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9461 artifacts, generated triage reflects the endpoint-selection slice, diff hygiene passes, and the full solution test suite remains green.
status_summary: The RFC 9461 DNS SVCB endpoint-selection floor is trace-owned and verified. DNS wire RR parsing, AliasMode operator guidance, HTTP request dispatch, and resolver fallback policy remain future work.
